brief: A poster for a neighbourhood jazz night on Friday 14 March at The Lantern, 8pm, free entry.
without: A poster for a neighbourhood jazz night on Friday 14 March at The Lantern, 8pm, free entry.
with: Event poster, portrait 3:4. Text, exactly and only: 'Neighbourhood Jazz Night', 'Friday 14 March', '8pm', 'The Lantern', 'Free entry'. No other words, no address, no slogans, no logos. Hierarchy: the title largest, top left; then date and time; then the venue; 'Free entry' smallest. Two typefaces only: a high-contrast serif for the title and a plain sans for the facts. All text sits on calm, flat areas of dark sky with strong contrast, with generous, even margins. Image: a quiet city street at night, one warm street lamp as the only light source, a double bass leaning in the lamp's pool of light with clear space between the bass and the lamp post; the lamp at true street-lamp height next to the bass. Value plan: dark blue night, the lit pool the brightest area and the focal point, nothing else competing. Palette: deep navy and blue-black with warm amber light and cream, at most three hues. Painterly but clean surfaces: no grain, no speckle, no sparkles, no lens flare.

brief: Poster, calm. "Moth Night" at Hollin Botanic Garden: a guided after-dark walk to see moths. Saturday 6 June, 9:30pm. Meet at the Glasshouse gate. Free, booking needed: hollingarden.org/moths. Audience: local families and adults.
without: Poster, calm. "Moth Night" at Hollin Botanic Garden: a guided after-dark walk to see moths. Saturday 6 June, 9:30pm. Meet at the Glasshouse gate. Free, booking needed: hollingarden.org/moths. Audience: local families and adults.
with: Calm event poster, portrait 3:4, for local families and adults. Text, exactly and only: 'Moth Night', 'Hollin Botanic Garden', 'A guided after-dark walk to see moths', 'Saturday 6 June, 9:30pm', 'Meet at the Glasshouse gate', 'Free, booking needed: hollingarden.org/moths'. Spell the web address exactly. No other words. Hierarchy: 'Moth Night' largest; then the date and time; then the meeting point; the booking line smallest but readable. Two typefaces: an elegant serif for the title, a plain sans for the details. All text on a flat, dark, quiet area with high contrast, every text block on one shared left edge. Image: a botanic garden at night with the glasshouse behind; a few moths drawn accurately (true moth wing shapes, feathery antennae) around one soft lantern by the glasshouse gate; that lantern is the only light. Value plan: deep blue-green dark garden, the lantern and moths the brightest focal area, a large calm dark area for the text. Palette: midnight teal, moss green and soft warm cream light, muted, at most three hues. No grain, no sparkles, no people, no other creatures.

brief: Poster, loud. Gig poster for the noise-rock band Static Choir with support from Lull. Thursday 22 May, doors 7:30pm, The Coal Shed, £8 on the door. Type-led.
without: Poster, loud. Gig poster for the noise-rock band Static Choir with support from Lull. Thursday 22 May, doors 7:30pm, The Coal Shed, £8 on the door. Type-led.
with: Type-led gig poster, portrait 3:4, loud and raw. Text, exactly and only: 'Static Choir', 'with support from Lull', 'Thursday 22 May', 'Doors 7:30pm', 'The Coal Shed', '£8 on the door'. No other words. Hierarchy: 'Static Choir' huge, filling the width, the headliner unmistakably biggest; 'Lull' clearly secondary, about a third of that size; the facts in one compact block. Two typefaces at most: a heavy condensed grotesque for the band name and a plain monospace for the facts. Graphic treatment: the headline cut by a few horizontal interference slices like a bad TV signal, flat colour, high contrast: black, off-white and one acid yellow-green. Every letter stays readable; the facts are set clean on flat colour. No photos, no instruments, no people, no extra slogans, no invented logos.

brief: A cover illustration for a children's book about a fox who loves reading.
without: A cover illustration for a children's book about a fox who loves reading.
with: Children's picture-book cover, portrait 3:4, for ages about 4 to 8. Text exactly: the working title 'A Fox Who Loves Reading' and the placeholder 'AUTHOR NAME'; no other words, no writing on book spines or signs. Title on a calm area of plain sky at the top, author name at the bottom, both high contrast, one friendly rounded typeface family. Image: a young red fox sitting under a tree reading an open book held in both front paws; correct fox anatomy (four legs, one tail, two front paws on the book). The book is plain paper and does not glow. One light: a low warm sun from the left. The fox and the book are the focal point. Palette: fox orange and warm page light against sage green and pale blue sky. Soft, simplified shapes with a clean flat gouache texture: no grain or speckle, no rainbow colours, no other animals.

brief: Ink illustration (black ink, one spot colour allowed) opening a magazine short story, "The Last Keeper": a lighthouse keeper's final night before the light is automated. No text in the image.
without: Ink illustration (black ink, one spot colour allowed) opening a magazine short story, "The Last Keeper": a lighthouse keeper's final night before the light is automated. No text in the image.
with: Magazine short-story opener illustration, landscape 4:3, black ink plus one spot colour, warm amber. No text or letters anywhere. Subject, exactly: a lighthouse keeper on his final night before the light is automated; show the keeper and the lighthouse and nothing the brief doesn't give (no suitcase, no departure, no boats). Composition: the keeper small, at the gallery rail beside the lamp room; the lighthouse beam is the only light and the only amber in the image, a strong diagonal across a large calm area of night sea and sky. Value plan: mostly mid-to-dark ink hatching, the lit lamp brightest, the keeper lit from the lamp side only. Confident ink line and controlled cross-hatching, not noisy; no grey wash, no other colours, no clutter of stars.

brief: Web page. Desktop landing page hero (1280x800) for Crumb & Co, a small-batch sourdough bakery in Leeds. Must show: name, one-line pitch, "Order for Saturday collection" button, opening hours (Wed-Sat 8am-2pm).
without: Web page. Desktop landing page hero (1280x800) for Crumb & Co, a small-batch sourdough bakery in Leeds. Must show: name, one-line pitch, "Order for Saturday collection" button, opening hours (Wed-Sat 8am-2pm).
with: A desktop website landing-page hero as a flat UI screenshot, 16:9, no browser window. Text, exactly and only: the wordmark 'Crumb & Co'; the headline 'Small-batch sourdough, baked in Leeds'; one primary button 'Order for Saturday collection'; the opening hours as a small schedule 'Wed–Sat 8am–2pm'; a minimal nav with 'Bread', 'Visit', 'Order'. No other words, no placeholder text, no reviews, no prices. Layout: text in the left column on a clear grid with generous margins; the right half a full-bleed photo of a sourdough loaf with a dark, blistered crust on a wooden board, side-lit from a window. Palette taken from the loaf: dark brown, toasted amber, flour cream; the button dark brown with cream text, high contrast. Two typefaces: a warm serif for the headline, a clean sans for everything else. One reading order: name, headline, button, hours.

brief: App screen. Phone "Today" screen (390x844) for a habit tracker called Tally. Must show: date (Sunday 1 November), 4 habits (Water 6/8 glasses, Read 20 min done, Walk 4,200/8,000 steps, Stretch not done), a streak (12 days), and an add button.
without: App screen. Phone "Today" screen (390x844) for a habit tracker called Tally. Must show: date (Sunday 1 November), 4 habits (Water 6/8 glasses, Read 20 min done, Walk 4,200/8,000 steps, Stretch not done), a streak (12 days), and an add button.
with: Phone app screen as a flat UI mockup, 9:16, no device frame, for a habit tracker called Tally. Text exactly: the app name 'Tally', the heading 'Today', the date 'Sunday 1 November'; four habit rows: 'Water' with '6/8 glasses', 'Read' with '20 min' marked done, 'Walk' with '4,200 / 8,000 steps', 'Stretch' marked not done; the streak '12 days' as the largest number on the screen; one round add button '+' at the bottom right. Layout: an 8-point spacing grid, generous margins, rows of equal height aligned to one edge, large tap targets. Palette: off-white background, near-black text, one green accent for progress; all text high contrast. One sans-serif family in two weights.
